items.promptEn: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장을 고르세요.
choices: The air after a shower smells freshly.
Mom got a box of colored paper for me.
Why does his voice sound strangely today?
You'd better tell your worries for your parents.
She decided to buy a new desk to her daughter.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [3–4] 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장을 고르세요.
choices: Dad made me to practice the piano for an hour.
Yesterday, she told me stop reading comic books.
We heard someone to shout from across the street.
The teacher ordered students be quiet in the classroom.
My mom helped me make sandwiches for tomorrow's picnic.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [5–6] 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn:
(Hanbok / my Chinese friends / showed / to / I)
→ ________________
accept: I showed Hanbok to my Chinese friends.
items.promptKo: 나는 나의 중국인 친구들에게 한복을 보여 주었다.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [5–6] 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn:
(come back / us / told / here / to / the tour guide)
→ ________________ by 5 o'clock.
accept: The tour guide told us to come back here
The tour guide told us to come back here by 5 o'clock.
items.promptKo: 여행 가이드는 우리에게 여기에 5시까지는 돌아오라고 했다.

• Your sister looks (A) when she plays with her puppy.
• Rules and laws will keep us (B).
choices: happy — safe
happily — safe
happy — safely
happily — safely
happiness — safe

• My dad got me (A) at home because I was sick.

choices: stay — help
stay — helping
to stay — help
to stay — to help
staying — helping

items.sectionInstructionKo: 9 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 made와 같은 의미로 쓰인 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn: <보기> Mom made me get up early today.
choices: I made my parents a pancake for breakfast.
She made several movies as a movie director.
The coach made Jake the captain of the baseball team.
The sunlight from the window made the room bright.
Dad made me look after my younger sister when he was out.

items.sectionInstructionKo: 10 다음 중 문장의 전환이 알맞지 않은 것을 모두 고르세요. 알맞은 보기 번호를 모두 골라 빈칸에 쓰세요. (순서 상관없음.)
items.promptEn:
① Don't tell anyone my secret.
→ Don't tell my secret to anyone.
② Paul asked his teacher a question.
→ Paul asked a question of his teacher.
③ Would you get some tissue for me?
→ Would you get for me some tissue.
④ I taught my friends a new card game.
→ I taught to my friends a new card game.
⑤ Chris sent me a package from America.
→ Chris sent a package from America of me.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [11–12] 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요. 틀린 말과 고친 말을 각각 한 칸에 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn: Fresh vegetables will make you health.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [11–12] 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요. 틀린 말과 고친 말을 각각 한 칸에 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)

items.sectionInstructionKo: 14 다음 중 빈칸에 to를 쓸 수 있는 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn: 빈칸에 to를 쓸 수 있는 문장을 고르세요.
choices: I saw him ________ sing in his room.
We want you ________ help us with our project.
Mr. Parker had the boys ________ keep silent for a while.
When Sally came home, she heard her baby ________ cry.
Dad made me ________ take a music lesson during the summer vacation.

items.promptEn: 그가 집에 도착했을 때 무언가 타는 냄새를 맡았다.
choices: He burned something to smell when he arrived home.
He burned something smelling when he arrived home.
He smelled something to burn when he arrived home.
He smelled something burning when he arrived home.
He smelled something to burning when he arrived home.
